skillBodyMaxCharsReason: After a compaction Claude Code re-attaches only the first 20,000 chars of each invoked SKILL.md, frontmatter stripped: about 130 go to the 'Base directory for this skill' header and 98 to the truncation marker. A body of 19,000 chars or less comes back whole, every gate included.
gateLineReason: A line naming a STOP, ⏸, GATE or Approved stamp that ends past char 19,000 of the body is cut from the re-attached skill, so the gate is gone after a compaction.
descriptionMaxCharsReason: The skill listing cuts description plus when_to_use at 1,536 chars.
bundleMaxCharsReason: A bundle is read in full at every skill start; it grows only by displacing other text. 0.35.0 raised setup (its templates cite the verification ladder, the app-visible and real-data rules) and tracker (the profile-doc history rule and the tracker next-file key) once, and execute and plan once for *A driven app is addressed by identity*: a backend plan schedules, and a backend build, test or fix session runs, Boot & Smoke and seam smokes that drive the client, so the rule moved from rules/ui.md into both bundles and a client session still reads it once. The rules each bundle carries are named in rules/applicability.json.
compactDigestReason: inject-compact.js adds the active skill's ## Gates section and must stay under 9,000 chars; a hook output over 10,000 chars is replaced by a 2,000-char preview.
plainLanguageGuideReason: inject-language-guide.js injects the guide with a short preface; its output must stay under 9,000 chars, or the 10,000-char hook cap swaps it for a 2,000-char preview.
principlesMaxCharsReason: 0.35.0 added the session, batch-reads and profile-doc history rules; any further rule text displaces old text.
